description: An empty CARDFILE reaching end of file on its very first READ: the shortest normal completion the program has, and the only one of the twenty cases that emits nothing at all between the two banners. The dataset is declared with "empty": true plus its 150-byte "recordLength" and the "copybook" CVACT02Y that describes the rows it would hold, which is a positive assertion that a real dataset was opened and yielded no record. That is deliberately not the same statement as omitting CARDFILE from "inputs" altogether, which would say nothing about the dataset and could not reach this branch - an empty declaration is the only way to reach a FILE STATUS of '10' on a first READ. It is equally not case16, which seeds this identical empty input and then fails its CLOSE, ending at RETURN-CODE 12 through 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM; here every I/O succeeds. Control flow: app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:71 displays the start banner; :72 performs 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN, where :121 finds CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' and :122 moves 0 into APPL-RESULT so 88 APPL-AOK (:62) holds - the openBrowse call site, openBrowse rather than startBrowse because this program tests its own OPEN and startBrowse is the online counterpart. :74 enters PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' for a first iteration, the guard at :75 holds, and :76 performs 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT, whose READ at :93 - the readNext call site - reports '10'; :98 recognises it and :99 moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, so :104 IF APPL-AOK takes its ELSE, :107 IF APPL-EOF takes its THEN, and :108 moves 'Y' into END-OF-FILE. The inner guard at :77 now sees 'Y' and suppresses DISPLAY CARD-RECORD at :78, which is precisely why no 150-character record image appears below. The loop ends, :83 performs 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE - the endBrowse call site - which reports '00' at :139, :85 displays the end banner and :87 reaches GOBACK. The status sequence across the three call sites is therefore '00', '10', '00'. The 16 is an internal marker and never a return code: 88 APPL-EOF VALUE 16 at :63 is a WORKING-STORAGE condition on a COMP field that only decides whether an unsuccessful read was an orderly end of file or a genuine failure, and nothing moves it toward RETURN-CODE. RETURN-CODE does not appear anywhere in the program's 178 lines, so a run reaching :87 completes with 0, and the only other value CBACT02C can produce is the 12 its error arms move into APPL-RESULT on the way to CALL 'CEE3ABD' at :158. The unit is account.AccountBalanceReaderJob, whose mandated name misdescribes its data on both counts: it reads the CARD master, not the account file - :29 selects CARDFILE, :32 keys on FD-CARD-NUM, the FD at :37-40 is 150 bytes, :45 copies CVACT02Y, and app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:25 binds the single input DD to the card data - so the name is kept verbatim and the behaviour is taken from the source (rule R1). Widths were hand-derived from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy: CARD-NUM X(16) at 1-16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) at 17-27, CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) at 28-30, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) at 31-80, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) at 81-90 with the copybook's own misspelling preserved, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) at 91 and FILLER X(59) at 92-150, summing to exactly 150; no image is emitted here, so that width is carried by "recordLength" instead. READCARD.jcl:22 declares STEP05 EXEC PGM=CBACT02C with no PARM, so "jobParameters" is empty; the program contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE, so the two expectation lists are empty rather than absent and assert positively that nothing was written and nothing was left behind. The empty row declaration and both empty lists are deliberate values, not placeholders awaiting data. Bytes are US-ASCII, the code page of the nine authoritative fixtures under app/data/ASCII, never a platform default. Provenance: statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy and app/jcl/READCARD.jcl, and never captured from a live COBOL run - section 0.7.6 of the plan proves execution impossible here with eight verified blockers, among them no z/OS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, and no Language Environment CEE services - recorded as risk R-A. Gates pinned: G15, G18, G47 and G51; no record image is emitted, so G19 and G21 are left to the cases that emit one.
